verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents native BM25 full-text search on string and []string attributes (docs-15). It also offers trigram-indexed regex search (docs-2) and positions itself as a combined vector and full-text search engine (docs-38, probe-1), so no separate search engine is needed. Server-side RRF fusion and multi-queries let keyword results combine with vector results in the same database (docs-16, docs-20). missing for 10: detail on tokenization, language analyzers and phrase or fuzzy query support, and independent or hands-on corroboration of full-text search quality.
